floater.name: skin_import_fs
floater.title: IMPORT A FIRESTORM SKIN
floater.floater.string: No Firestorm skins found. Use Browse to pick a Firestorm skins, skin or theme folder.
floater.text: Pick a Firestorm skin and theme. Its colours and images are converted into a new skin here; colours and images this viewer does not use are skipped, and anything broken keeps ours. Nothing in Firestorm is changed.

check_box.label: Include layout files (advanced)
check_box.name: include_layout
check_box.tool_tip: Also import the skin's layout (XUI) files. Each one is checked against ours and skipped if it would remove controls this viewer needs.

button.label: Browse...
button.name: browse_btn
button.tool_tip: Pick a Firestorm skins folder, one skin folder, or one theme folder (skins/<skin>/themes/<theme>).
